## SAFE Metric Calculation

### Creating a Space of Ground Balls


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
create_bb_space <- function(bip_gb, spray_angle_seq, launch_speed_seq) {
  
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2D Kernel Density of Ground Balls by Spray Angle and Launch Speed
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
  XY <- cbind(bip_gb$spray_angle, bip_gb$launch_speed)
  kde_fit <- kde(x = XY)
  
  batted_balls <- expand.grid(
    spray_angle = spray_angle_seq,
    launch_speed = launch_speed_seq
  )
  
  # Evaluate KDE directly at each grid point
  batted_balls$density <- predict(
    kde_fit,
    x = cbind(batted_balls$spray_angle,
              batted_balls$launch_speed)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------------------------
  # Fitting a Run Consequence Model
  # -----------------------------------------------
  
  # Fitting a run consequence model; the expected number of runs on non-successful plays
  # as a smooth function of launch speed and spray angle
  mod_run_consequence <- gam(delta_run_exp ~ s(launch_speed) +
                                        s(spray_angle) + 
                                        launch_speed:spray_angle,
                    data = bip_gb |> filter(successful_play == 0))

  batted_balls$run_consequence <- predict(mod_run_consequence, 
                                          newdata = batted_balls
                                          )
  
  return(batted_balls)
}
```

### Functions to Fit SAFE Model for a Given Position and Year


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
prepare_SAFE_training_data <- function(bip_data, positioning_data, year,
                                       position, min_plays) {
  
  play_data <- bip_data |>
    filter(
      (successful_play == 1 & play_made_by == position) |
        successful_play == 0
    ) |>
    mutate(
      pos_x = positioning_data$pos_x,
      pos_y = positioning_data$pos_y,
      pos_angle = positioning_data$pos_angle,
      theta = abs(pos_angle - spray_angle),
      move_left = ifelse(spray_angle < pos_angle, 1, 0),
      fielder_id = case_when(
        position == "1B" ~ fielder_3,
        position == "2B" ~ fielder_4,
        position == "3B" ~ fielder_5,
        position == "SS" ~ fielder_6
      )
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(fielder_id), !is.na(launch_speed), !is.na(theta)) |>
    mutate(
      launch_speed_scaled = scale(launch_speed)[, 1],
      theta_scaled = scale(theta)[, 1],
      fielder_id = factor(fielder_id)
    )
  
  eligible_fielders <- play_data |>
    count(fielder_id, name = "num_plays") |>
    filter(num_plays >= min_plays) |>
    pull(fielder_id)

  play_data <- play_data |>
    filter(fielder_id %in% eligible_fielders)
  
  return(play_data)
}
```
:::

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
fit_SAFE_model <- function(play_data, position, max_retries = 3) {

  outcome <- paste0("out_", tolower(position))

  formulas <- list(
    full = as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome,
        " ~ theta_scaled +
           theta_scaled:move_left +
           theta_scaled:launch_speed_scaled +
           (1 + theta_scaled || fielder_id)"
      )
    ),
    intercept_only = as.formula(
      paste0(
        outcome,
        " ~ theta_scaled +
           theta_scaled:move_left +
           theta_scaled:launch_speed_scaled +
           (1 | fielder_id)"
      )
    )
  )

  for (attempt in seq_len(max_retries)) {

    f <- if (attempt == 1) formulas$full else formulas$intercept_only

    message("SAFE model fit attempt ", attempt, " for ", position)

    mod <- tryCatch(
      glmer(
        f,
        data = play_data,
        family = binomial(link = "probit"),
        control = glmerControl(
          optimizer = "bobyqa",
          optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
        )
      ),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )

    if (!is.null(mod)) return(mod)
  }

  NULL
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
extract_SAFE_scaler <- function(play_data) {
  list(
    launch_speed_mean = mean(play_data$launch_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    launch_speed_sd = sd(play_data$launch_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    theta_mean = mean(play_data$theta, na.rm = TRUE),
    theta_sd = sd(play_data$theta, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
compute_SAFE_player <- function(fielder_id, model, play_data, bb_space, 
                                scaler) {
  
  # Get number of opportunities for this fielder
  n_opportunities <- sum(play_data$fielder_id == fielder_id)
  
  # Create a copy of bb_space and assign this fielder
  bb_temp <- bb_space |>
    mutate(
      theta = abs(pos_angle - spray_angle),
      move_left = spray_angle < pos_angle,
      launch_speed_scaled =
        (launch_speed - scaler$launch_speed_mean) / scaler$launch_speed_sd,
      theta_scaled =
        (theta - scaler$theta_mean) / scaler$theta_sd
    )
  
  bb_temp$fielder_id <- factor(fielder_id, levels = levels(play_data$fielder_id))
  
  # Get predictions
  bb_temp <- bb_temp |>
    mutate(
      p_player = predict(model, newdata = bb_temp, type = "response"),
      p_avg = predict(model, newdata = bb_temp, type = "response", re.form = NA),
      PPA = p_player - p_avg,
      SAFE_component = PPA * run_consequence * density * n_opportunities
    )
  
  # Return both the data and summary
  list(
    data = bb_temp,
    SAFE = sum(bb_temp$SAFE_component, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_opportunities = n_opportunities
  )
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
compute_SAFE_all_players <- function(model, play_data, bb_space, scaler,
                                     position, year, keep_probs = FALSE) {
  
  # Get unique fielders as they appear in the training data
  fielders <- unique(play_data$fielder_id)
  
  # Initialize storage
  player_results <- list()
  player_probs <- list()
  safe_results <- data.frame()
  
  # Loop through each fielder
  for (fid in fielders) {
    
    result <- compute_SAFE_player(
      fielder_id = fid,
      model = model,
      play_data = play_data,
      bb_space = bb_space,
      scaler = scaler
    )
    
    # Store results
    player_results[[fid]] <- result
    
    # Add to summary data frame
    safe_results <- rbind(safe_results, data.frame(
      fielder_id = as.character(fid),
      position = position,
      year = year,
      n_opportunities = result$n_opportunities,
      SAFE = result$SAFE
    ))
    
    # Store probability data if requested
    if (keep_probs) {
      player_probs[[fid]] <- result$data
    }
  }
  
  if (keep_probs) {
    return(list(
      safe_summary = safe_results,
      player_probs = player_probs
    ))
  }
  
  return(safe_results)
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
fit_SAFE_position_year <- function(
  bip_data,
  bb_space,
  positioning_data,
  year,
  position,
  min_plays = 300,
  max_retries = 3,
  keep_probs = FALSE
) {
  
  message("Preparing SAFE training data: ", position, " ", year)
  
  play_data <- prepare_SAFE_training_data(
    bip_data = bip_data,
    positioning_data = positioning_data,
    year = year,
    position = position,
    min_plays = min_plays
  )
  
  message("Fitting SAFE probability model: ", position, " ", year)
  
  model <- fit_SAFE_model(
    play_data = play_data,
    position = position,
    max_retries = max_retries
  )
  
  if (is.null(model)) {
    warning("SAFE model failed for ", position, " ", year)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  scaler <- extract_SAFE_scaler(play_data)
  
  message("Computing SAFE values: ", position, " ", year)
  
  compute_SAFE_all_players(
    model = model,
    play_data = play_data,
    bb_space = bb_space,
    scaler = scaler,
    position = position,
    year = year,
    keep_probs = keep_probs 
  )
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
fit_SAFE <- function(bip_data, year, position, positioning_data, bb_space, max_retries = 3) {
  
  # Merge position coordinates onto play data, filter to year, and compute features
  play_data <- bip_data |>
    filter(
      (successful_play == 1 & play_made_by == position) | (successful_play == 0)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      pos_x = positioning_data$pos_x,
      pos_y = positioning_data$pos_y,
      pos_angle = positioning_data$pos_angle,
      theta = abs(pos_angle - spray_angle),
      move_left = ifelse(spray_angle < pos_angle, 1, 0),
      fielder_id = case_when(
        position == "1B" ~ fielder_3,
        position == "2B" ~ fielder_4,
        position == "3B" ~ fielder_5,
        position == "SS" ~ fielder_6,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    ) |>
    # scaling continuous variables
    mutate(
      launch_speed_scaled = scale(launch_speed)[,1],
      theta_scaled = scale(theta)[,1]
    ) |>
    # filter out NA for all variables used in the model
    filter(
      !is.na(fielder_id),
      !is.na(launch_speed),
      !is.na(theta)
    )
  
  players_num_plays <- play_data |>
    group_by(fielder_id) |>
    summarise(num_plays = n()) |>
    arrange(num_plays) |>
    filter(num_plays >= 350) |>
    pluck("fielder_id")

  play_data <- play_data |>
    filter(fielder_id %in% players_num_plays) |>
    mutate(fielder_id = factor(fielder_id))
  
  # ---------------------------- PROBABILITY MODEL -----------------------------
  
  # Create the outcome variable name dynamically
  outcome_var <- paste0("out_", str_to_lower(position))
  
  formula_str_player <- paste0(
    outcome_var, " ~ 1 + theta_scaled + theta_scaled:move_left + ",
    "theta_scaled:launch_speed_scaled + ",
    "(1 + theta_scaled || fielder_id)"
  )
  
  mod_player <- NULL
  attempt <- 1
  
  while(is.null(mod_player) && attempt <= max_retries) {
    
    tryCatch({
      
      if (attempt == 1) {
        # First attempt: default bobyqa
        message(paste("Fitting model for", position, year, "- Attempt", attempt))
        mod_player <- glmer(
          formula = as.formula(formula_str_player),
          data = play_data,
          family = binomial(link = "probit"),
          control = glmerControl(
            optimizer = "bobyqa",
            optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
          )
        )
        
      } else if (attempt == 2) {
        # Second attempt: Simplify random effects (intercept only)
        message(paste("Retrying with simplified random effects for", position, year))
        formula_str_simple <- paste0(
          outcome_var, " ~ 1 + theta_scaled + theta_scaled:move_left + ",
          "theta_scaled:launch_speed_scaled + ",
          "(1 | fielder_id)"  # Only random intercept
        )
        mod_player <- glmer(
          formula = as.formula(formula_str_simple),
          data = play_data,
          family = binomial(link = "probit"),
          control = glmerControl(
            optimizer = "bobyqa",
            optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
          )
        )
      }
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message(paste("Attempt", attempt, "failed for", position, year, ":", e$message))
      mod_player <<- NULL
    })
    
    attempt <- attempt + 1
  }
  
  # If all attempts failed, return empty results
  if (is.null(mod_player)) {
    warning(paste("All attempts failed for", position, year, "- returning empty results"))
    return(data.frame(
      fielder_id = character(),
      position = character(),
      year = numeric(),
      SAFE = numeric()
    ))
  }
  
  message(paste("Successfully fit model for", position, year))
  
  
  # ---------------------- CALCULATING SAFE METRICS ----------------------------
  
  batted_balls <- batted_balls |>
    mutate(
      pos_angle = positioning_data$pos_angle,
      theta = abs(pos_angle - spray_angle),
      move_left = ifelse(spray_angle < pos_angle, 1, 0),
      # standardize variables based on training data
      launch_speed_scaled = (launch_speed - mean(play_data$launch_speed, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(play_data$launch_speed, na.rm = TRUE),
      theta_scaled = (theta - mean(play_data$theta, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(play_data$theta, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  fielders <- unique(play_data$fielder_id)
  
  # Set up a data frame to store SAFE results
  safe_results <- data.frame()
  
  for (fielder in fielders) {
    
    bb_temp <- batted_balls
    bb_temp$fielder_id <- factor(fielder, levels = levels(play_data$fielder_id))
    n_opportunities <- nrow(play_data |> filter(fielder_id == fielder))
    
    # Check that this fielder exists in the model
    if (!(fielder %in% levels(play_data$fielder_id))) {
      next
    }
    
    bb_temp <- bb_temp |>
      mutate(
        prob_play_player = predict(mod_player, newdata = bb_temp, type = "response"),
        prob_play_avg = predict(mod_player, newdata = bb_temp, type = "response", re.form = NA),
        prob_play_added = prob_play_player - prob_play_avg,
        SAFE = prob_play_added * run_consequence * density
      ) 
    
    player_res <- bb_temp |>
      summarize(
        SAFE = sum(SAFE, na.rm = TRUE) * n_opportunities
      )
    
    # append fielderid, position, SAFE, and num_plays to safe_results
    safe_results <- rbind(safe_results, data.frame(
      fielder_id = as.character(fielder),
      position = position,
      year = year,
      n_opportunities = n_opportunities,
      SAFE = player_res$SAFE
    ))

  }
  
  return(safe_results)
  
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
years <- c(2023, 2024, 2025)
positions <- c("1B", "2B", "SS", "3B")

all_safe_results <- list()

for (year in years) {
  
  bip_year <- bip_gb |>
    filter(game_year == year)
  
  for (position in positions) {
    
    positioning_pos <- safe_positioning |>
      filter(play_made_by == position)
    
    # Add pos_angle to bb_space for this position
    bb_space_pos <- bb_space |>
      mutate(
        pos_angle = positioning_pos$pos_angle
      )
    
    res <- fit_SAFE_position_year(
      bip_data = bip_year,
      bb_space = bb_space_pos,
      positioning_data = positioning_pos,
      year = year,
      position = position,
      keep_probs = FALSE
    )
    
    if (!is.null(res)) {
      all_safe_results[[paste(year, position, sep = "_")]] <- res
    }
  }
}

safe_results <- bind_rows(all_safe_results)

# Save SAFE results
saveRDS(safe_results, "results/safe_results.rds")
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
prepare_SAFE_sc_training_data <- function(bip_data, sc_positioning, year,
                                       position, min_plays) {
  
  play_data <- bip_data |>
    filter(
      (successful_play == 1 & play_made_by == position) |
        successful_play == 0
    ) |>
    mutate(
      fielder_id = case_when(
        position == "1B" ~ fielder_3,
        position == "2B" ~ fielder_4,
        position == "3B" ~ fielder_5,
        position == "SS" ~ fielder_6
      )
    ) |>
    left_join(sc_positioning, 
              by = c("fielder_id", "stand" = "batter_hand"), relationship = "many-to-many"
              ) |>
    mutate(
      theta = abs(pos_angle - spray_angle),
      move_left = ifelse(spray_angle < pos_angle, 1, 0),
      launch_speed_scaled = scale(launch_speed)[,1],
      theta_scaled = scale(theta)[,1]
    ) |>
    filter(
      !is.na(fielder_id),
      !is.na(launch_speed),
      !is.na(theta)
    )
  
  eligible_fielders <- play_data |>
    count(fielder_id, name = "num_plays") |>
    filter(num_plays >= min_plays) |>
    pull(fielder_id)

  play_data <- play_data |>
    filter(fielder_id %in% eligible_fielders)
  
  return(play_data)
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
predict_SAFE_sc_avg <- function(model, bb_space, avg_positioning, scaler) {

  bb_space_avg <- bb_space |>
    left_join(avg_positioning, by = "batter_hand") |>
    mutate(
      theta = abs(avg_pos_angle - spray_angle),
      theta_scaled = (theta - scaler$theta_mean) / scaler$theta_sd,
      move_left = spray_angle < avg_pos_angle
    )
  
  bb_space_avg$p_avg <- predict(model, newdata = bb_space_avg, type = "response", re.form = NA)
  
  return(bb_space_avg)
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
compute_SAFE_sc_player <- function(fielder_id, model, play_data, sc_positioning, 
                                   bb_space, scaler) {
  
  # Get number of opportunities for this fielder
  n_opportunities <- sum(play_data$fielder_id == fielder_id)
  
  sc_pos_player <- sc_positioning |>
    filter(fielder_id == !!fielder_id)
  
  if (nrow(sc_pos_player) < 2) {
    missing_hands <- setdiff(c("L", "R"), sc_pos_player$batter_hand)
    for (hand in missing_hands) {
      avg_angle <- avg_positioning |>
        filter(batter_hand == hand) |>
        pluck("avg_pos_angle")
      sc_pos_player <- rbind(sc_pos_player, data.frame(
        fielder_id = fielder_id,  # Add this
        batter_hand = hand, 
        pos_angle = avg_angle
      ))
    }
  }
  
  # Create a copy of bb_space and assign this fielder
  bb_temp <- bb_space |>
    left_join(
      sc_pos_player,
      by = c("batter_hand")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      theta = abs(pos_angle - spray_angle),
      move_left = spray_angle < pos_angle,
      launch_speed_scaled =
        (launch_speed - scaler$launch_speed_mean) / scaler$launch_speed_sd,
      theta_scaled =
        (theta - scaler$theta_mean) / scaler$theta_sd
    )
  
  play_data$fielder_id <- factor(play_data$fielder_id)
  bb_temp$fielder_id <- factor(fielder_id, levels = levels(play_data$fielder_id))
  bb_temp$p_player <- predict(model, newdata = bb_temp, type = "response")
  bb_temp$p_avg <- predict(model, newdata = bb_temp, type = "response", re.form = NA)
  
  # Get predictions
  bb_temp <- bb_temp |>
    mutate(
      PPA = p_player - p_avg,
      SAFE_component = (PPA * run_consequence * density * n_opportunities) / 2
    )
  
  # Return both the data and summary
  list(
    data = bb_temp,
    SAFE = sum(bb_temp$SAFE_component, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_opportunities = n_opportunities
  )
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
compute_SAFE_sc_all_players <- function(
  model,
  play_data,
  bb_space,
  sc_pos_position,
  scaler,
  position,
  year,
  keep_probs
) {

  fielders <- unique(play_data$fielder_id)

  # Initialize storage
  player_results <- list()
  player_probs <- list()
  safe_results <- data.frame()
  
  # Loop through each fielder
  for (fid in fielders) {
    
    result <- compute_SAFE_sc_player(
      fielder_id = fid,
      model = model,
      play_data = play_data,
      sc_positioning = sc_pos_position,
      bb_space = bb_space,
      scaler = scaler
    )
    
    # Store results
    player_results[[fid]] <- result
    
    # Add to summary data frame
    safe_results <- rbind(safe_results, data.frame(
      fielder_id = as.character(fid),
      position = position,
      year = year,
      SAFE = result$SAFE
    ))
    
    # Store probability data if requested
    if (keep_probs) {
      fid_chr = as.character(fid)
      player_probs[[fid_chr]] <- result$data
    }
  }
  
  if (keep_probs) {
    return(list(
      safe_summary = safe_results,
      player_probs = player_probs
    ))
  }
  
  return(safe_results)
}
```

```{.r .cell-code .hidden}
fit_SAFE_sc_position_year <- function(
  bip_data,
  bb_space,
  sc_positioning,
  year,
  position,
  min_plays = 300,
  max_retries = 3,
  keep_probs
) {

  message("Preparing SAFE training data: ", position, " ", year)
  
  sc_pos_position <- prepare_sc_positioning(sc_positioning, year, position)
  play_data <- prepare_SAFE_sc_training_data(bip_data, sc_pos_position, year,
                                             position, min_plays)

  if (nrow(play_data) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  message("Fitting SAFE probability model: ", position, " ", year)
  model <- fit_SAFE_model(play_data, position, 3)

  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)

  scaler <- extract_SAFE_scaler(play_data)

  message("Computing SAFE values: ", position, " ", year)
  compute_SAFE_sc_all_players(
    model,
    play_data,
    bb_space,
    sc_pos_position,
    scaler,
    position,
    year,
    keep_probs
  )
}
```
